## 专业目录覆盖记录

**官方目录仍在补齐**，共 159 项；这不是全字段详情的完成状态。

<p><strong>统计范围：</strong>Lettres full bachelor-level catalogue cards, Science eight mentions and named double/intensive/apprenticeship/professional routes, health first-cycle/grade-licence programmes.</p>

<p><strong>对账方法：</strong>Lettres all22 pages of public search service fetched;214 unique cards exactly reconcile all diploma facets. Included37 Licence+30 Double licence+8 LAS+8 Majeure/mineure+3 LP+3 undergraduate double diploma=89. Science full licence tree and8 disciplinary pages read;16 science-science doubles,7 professional licences and all named intensive/apprenticeship indexes read. Health overview and all listed paramedical/university-affiliated branch pages read.</p>

<p><strong>排除项：</strong>Exclude Masters, graduate concours preparations, generic DU, standalone minors, individual units. L1–L3 ordinary year pages stored as curriculum_stages under their programme. Merge5 science/humanities joint programme duplicates with Lettres identities. Explicitly identify first-cycle stages; not all entries are independent bachelor awards. Original French titles kept.</p>

**尚未解决的目录缺口：**

- Lettres programme-card inventory is complete; all embedded subtracks under L3 year pages have not yet been separately normalized as programme identities.
- Science eight mentions and explicit indexed routes are covered, but full reconciliation of every intra-major option, all joint-curriculum branches and CMI bachelor-bearing pathways is incomplete. Do not claim whole-university completeness.
- Psychomotricité and Kinésithérapie were read but not assigned a bachelor/grade-licence award without clearer collected evidence. Complete medical/paramedical institutional and cohort-specific award perimeter remains to be reconciled.
- Maïeutique source distinguishes new six-year reform and legacy first-cycle structure. Orthophonie is explicitly a first-cycle stage, with final master-level qualification.
